text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أَنْ أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ وَذَكِّرْهُم بِأَيَّىٰمِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that links the Mosaic case to the prior messenger principle while beginning a fresh narrative instance
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as both connection and resumption. It ties the Mosaic example back to the messenger principle in 14:4 while letting the verse start a new named demonstration rather than a mere continuation clause.

topics.headline: connection from rule to Mosaic instance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Mosaic narrative is attached to the universal messenger rule rather than standing as an isolated story.
topics.reason: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) can coordinate and resume; the boundary evidence supports a turn from the prior rule to this concrete instance.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām in the opening laqad frame, giving the sending oath-like certification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: certification particle in the opening assertion frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the compact assertion frame of {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) plus {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) plus the perfect verb. Its force is not just volume; it gives the sending oath-pressure and places the rest of the commission under a certified opening fact.

topics.headline: oath-like certification of the sending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the sending introduced as a certified fact before any command unfolds.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) as emphatic lām prefixed to {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), and the CRITICAL rows consistently scope it over the perfect sending clause.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before a perfect verb, marking accomplished reality rather than possibility

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Form IV perfect sending verb that heads the commission

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) selects realization with the perfect {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}). It blocks a merely occasional or tentative reading and makes the extraction and remembrance commands depend on an already established divine dispatch.

topics.headline: completed sending certified before the commands
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the later imperatives as consequences of an accomplished commission, not optional exhortations.
topics.reason: The particle precedes the perfect verb {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}), so local aspect selects taḥqīq rather than a probabilistic or habitual value.

words.gloss_range: Form IV perfect divine dispatch: a completed, speaker-marked sending that embeds the mandate
words.root_gloss_range: release, loosened flow, dispatch, and mission; local Form IV perfect selects causative commissioned sending

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: particle opening the governed command content

words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) is the ayah's certified base act: the divine speaker is fused into the perfect verb, and Form IV turns root release into commissioned dispatch. The verb is not left as a bare sending formula, because it governs {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) and the paired imperatives, making the mission's content part of the dispatch itself. It also repeats the sending principle from 14:4 in a named Mosaic example, with parallels such as 20:24 and 26:15-16 remaining formulaic background rather than a replacement for the local syntax.

topics.headline: certified divine dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sending, completion, and divine agency packed into the first finite verb.
topics.reason: The perfect first-person plural Form IV verb is the head of the main clause and receives the opening {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}})-{{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) frame.

topics.headline: Form IV release becomes mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root field of release redirected into purposeful commissioning.
topics.reason: The broader release or looseness field survives as image-pressure, while local Form IV selects commissioned dispatch.

topics.headline: messenger rule becomes named example
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the universal sending rule of 14:4 becoming a particular Mosaic commission in 14:5.
topics.reason: The same sending root crosses the verse boundary and the Mūsā-sending formula is locally present.

topics.headline: sending contains quoted command content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that God sends Mūsā with a mandate whose content is then quoted.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) command clause the governed complement of {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}).

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name as direct object of the sending, preserving named prophetic identity

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Form IV perfect sending verb that heads the commission

words.prose: {{ar:مُوسَىٰ}} ({{tr:mūsā}}) turns the generic messenger principle into a named prophet. The foreign indeclinable form keeps his inherited identity visible while local position and valency make him the direct object of {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}). The name also stands in the familiar Mūsā-with-signs field, and the drawn-out name tradition can sharpen the coming extraction command without determining the parse.

topics.headline: foreign proper name as commissioned object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a universal rule has become a concrete named commission without forcing the name into Arabic morphology.
topics.reason: The aligned word is an indeclinable foreign proper noun functioning as the direct object of the sending verb.

topics.headline: Mūsā in the signs collocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes Mūsā here as the prophet whose commission is immediately equipped with signs.
topics.reason: The local sequence places the proper name directly before the signs phrase, matching recurring Mūsā-sign contexts such as 7:103, 10:75, and 17:101.

topics.headline: name image sharpens extraction role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a secondary fit between a drawn-out name tradition and the command to bring the people out.
topics.reason: The name tradition is kept as suggestive pressure only; the local grammar still treats the word as a foreign proper name.

words.gloss_range: bāʾ attaching the signs to the sending as accompaniment, instrument, and evidentiary warrant

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: Form IV perfect sending verb that heads the commission

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) ties the signs directly to {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}). It lets the signs be carried with the mission, function as its means, and, more narrowly, serve as evidentiary warrant, so the proof is not an afterthought added after the sending.

topics.headline: signs attached as equipment and means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the signs as built into the commission rather than appended later.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَآ}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) and attaches the phrase to {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}); accompaniment and instrument are directly licensed, while causal warrant is a qualified extension.

words.gloss_range: plural possessed signs: divine evidentiary equipment that later echoes as discoverable signs
words.root_gloss_range: sign, proof, marker, communicated sign; disputed return/refuge pressure is secondary to the local sign noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: indefinite signs discovered in the coda

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَآ}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) makes the mission's evidence plural and explicitly divine by the suffix. The noun can bridge visible sign, proof, and communicated marker, while the contested return-refuge derivation adds only a narrowed sense of stable recourse for a people being moved toward light. Its first occurrence is possessed equipment with Mūsā, later answered by indefinite {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}) as signs discerned in the event.

topics.headline: plural signs owned by the divine speaker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Mūsā is sent with a system of divine signs, not a generic or isolated marvel.
topics.reason: The plural sign noun with first-person plural suffix is governed by the preceding bāʾ and attached to the sending.

topics.headline: contested return-refuge pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the signs as points of return or refuge while the local word remains the sign noun.
topics.reason: The alternative derivational pressure is valid background, but it does not replace the local sign/proof sense.

topics.headline: possessed signs become discerned signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a frame from signs supplied with Mūsā to signs later recognized by qualified readers.
topics.reason: The same sign-root appears at {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَآ}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) and {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}), and boundary evidence links signs with the communicative clarification of 14:4.

words.gloss_range: explicative or purpose-linking particle that opens the governed command content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first imperative, the extraction command
second imperative, the reminder command

words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the sending into stated mandate. It can be read as explicative or as a maṣdar-like purpose link, but in either case it keeps {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) and {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) under the one commissioned content rather than letting the imperatives float independently.

topics.headline: particle opening both imperatives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that extraction and remembrance are one governed mandate inside the sending.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) clause the complement of {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) and extends its scope across the coordinated imperatives.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperative: cause the people to exit along a complete source-to-goal route
words.root_gloss_range: going out, exit, outlet, rupture; local Form IV imperative selects caused extraction rather than intransitive exit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition in the extraction route
endpoint preposition in the extraction route

words.prose: {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) is a direct second-person command to Mūsā, embedded inside the divine commission. Form IV makes him cause the people to exit, and the following {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) ... {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) route turns the action into a complete movement from source to destination. The root's outlet image concretizes escape, while tax or rebellion branches remain background only; the phrase echoes the surah opening in 14:1.

topics.headline: quoted command inside the commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command as divine speech content addressed to Mūsā, not narrator summary.
topics.reason: The imperative is embedded after {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) and addressed to the commissioned prophet.

topics.headline: causative extraction along a full route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees liberation as a caused, directional extraction from a named source to a named goal.
topics.reason: Form IV licenses caused exit, and {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) plus {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) supply source and endpoint.

topics.headline: outlet image and 14:1 echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this extraction with the surah-opening darkness-to-light task in 14:1 while keeping the local command primary.
topics.reason: The outlet and rupture field supports the image, but local grammar selects caused exit; the 14:1 echo is formulaic reinforcement.

words.gloss_range: possessed singular collective: Mūsā’s specific people as the unified object of extraction
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, people, station, and judgment associations; local noun selects a collective community
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمَكَ}} ({{tr:qawmaka}}) is singular in form but collective in reference, so the command can take one object while meaning a whole people. The suffix binds that collective to Mūsā as his charge, turning 14:4's generic messenger-people relation into the concrete phrase 'your people.' The standing-root pressure can suggest a people to be raised into a new condition, but the local noun remains the community object.

topics.headline: your people as prophetic charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the extracted group as Mūsā’s assigned responsibility, not an unnamed population.
topics.reason: The 2ms possessive suffix definitizes and routes the collective to the addressed prophet.

topics.headline: one grammatical object, many people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a whole social body is grammatically compressed into one patient of extraction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:قَوْمَكَ}} ({{tr:qawmaka}}) the direct object of {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}).

topics.headline: standing-root pressure on peoplehood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense the people as a community meant to stand in a new condition, without turning the noun away from peoplehood.
topics.reason: The standing and resurrection field is relevant root pressure but the local lexical unit is the collective people noun.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking separation from the darknesses

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite plural darknesses as the route source
endpoint preposition in the extraction route

words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) gives the extraction its starting point. In this frame it is ablative source or separation, not a partitive 'some of' reading: the people are to leave the condition named by {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}), and the later {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) completes the directional pair.

topics.headline: source and separation, not partition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees darkness as the condition to be exited, not material partly taken from.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}) under the motion command {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) and pairs with {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}).

words.gloss_range: definite plural darknesses: a known, layered source condition contrasted with singular light
words.root_gloss_range: darkness and injustice or misplacement; local plural noun selects layered darkness with moral pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: definite singular light as the route goal

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}) is definite and plural, so the source is a known field of darknesses rather than an abstract lack of light. The plural stands against singular {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}), making error, oppression, and obscurity multiple while the goal is unified. The root's injustice or misplacement pressure makes extraction feel restorative, though the qirāʾāt vowel-lightening only affects pronunciation, not the plural mechanism.

topics.headline: known layered darknesses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the starting condition as definite and layered, not vague gloom.
topics.reason: The noun is definite plural and governed by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) as the source of extraction.

topics.headline: many darknesses against one light
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the number contrast: multiple darknesses are answered by one light and then interpreted by patience and gratitude.
topics.reason: The local pair {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}) and {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}) forms the ayah's central directional contrast.

topics.headline: misplacement pressure with pronunciation variant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel darkness as unjust misplacement from which the people must be removed, while variant sound evidence does not alter the local plural sense.
topics.reason: The injustice branch gives moral pressure; the qirāʾāt note lightens the vocalization without changing the plural lexeme or syntax.

words.gloss_range: endpoint preposition marking directed arrival at light

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition in the extraction route
definite singular light as the route goal

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) completes the movement begun by {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}). It makes {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}) a destination and limit, so the command is not only departure from darkness but arrival at a named endpoint.

topics.headline: destination particle completing the route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command as a full source-to-goal journey rather than open-ended escape.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}) and balances the earlier source marker {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}).

words.gloss_range: definite singular light: the unified endpoint of the extraction route
words.root_gloss_range: illumination and manifestation; local noun selects light, not fire or combustion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: endpoint preposition in the extraction route
definite plural darknesses as the route source

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنُّورِ}} ({{tr:al-nūri}}) is definite, singular, and governed by {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}), so it names a recognized destination rather than one possible brightness. Its singularity concentrates the contrast with plural {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}). The root field must be narrowed away from fire: the endpoint is illumination and knowability, and it participates in a recurring darkness-to-light extraction formula (2:257, 33:43, 57:9).

topics.headline: known unified light as endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the route contract from many darknesses into one known light.
topics.reason: The singular definite noun is the object of {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) and stands opposite plural {{ar:ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ẓulumāti}}).

topics.headline: illumination rather than combustion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the destination in the register of guidance and clarity, not destructive fire.
topics.reason: The root field includes nearby fire vocabulary, but the local lexical unit is the light noun.

topics.headline: darkness-to-light formula completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the phrase as part of a broader guidance formula while seeing Mūsā as the local commanded agent.
topics.reason: The local kh-r-j frame matches recurring darkness-to-light passages such as 2:257, 33:43, and 57:9.

words.gloss_range: conjunction coordinating the second imperative with the extraction command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second imperative, the reminder command
first imperative, the extraction command

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) beside {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) as a second command under the same mandate. The result is not movement alone and not memory alone: the commission joins spatial extraction with temporal remembrance.

topics.headline: second command coordinated with the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembrance is co-commissioned with liberation rather than added as an afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) clause with the earlier {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) imperative.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperative with object suffix: cause the same people to remember divine days repeatedly
words.root_gloss_range: remembrance and making-present; other root associations remain secondary to the local reminding command

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: possessed collective people addressed through Mūsā
first imperative, the extraction command

words.prose: {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) compresses command and audience: the suffix points back to {{ar:قَوْمَكَ}} ({{tr:qawmaka}}), so the same people being extracted must also be instructed in memory. Form II makes the reminder intensive or repeated, turning past divine days into present awareness. Together with {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}), it makes the mandate both spatial and temporal, and it opens a surah-wide remembrance thread that continues in 14:6 and 14:52.

topics.headline: object suffix returns to the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the extracted people and the reminded people as the same group.
topics.reason: The 3mp suffix in {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) refers back to {{ar:قَوْمَكَ}} ({{tr:qawmaka}}).

topics.headline: Form II repeated making-present
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears remembrance as repeated activation of awareness, not a single notice.
topics.reason: The Form II imperative governs a bāʾ phrase naming the content of remembrance.

topics.headline: liberation joined to historical consciousness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prophetic mission as both moving the people and reorienting their memory.
topics.reason: The coordinated imperatives {{ar:أَخْرِجْ}} ({{tr:akhrij}}) and {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) form the command pair.

topics.headline: remembrance thread across the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to remind is immediately enacted in 14:6 and remains active through 14:52.
topics.reason: The same root recurs in 14:6 and 14:52, making local remembrance part of a larger surah pattern.

words.gloss_range: bāʾ marking the content and instrument of the reminder

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second imperative, the reminder command

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) extends {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) beyond an object suffix to the material of instruction. It makes the divine days both what the people are reminded about and the medium through which memory is activated, echoing the earlier bāʾ that equipped the sending with signs.

topics.headline: divine days as memory content and means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees historical time itself become the material of prophetic reminding.
topics.reason: The preposition after {{ar:ذَكِّرْهُم}} ({{tr:dhakkirhum}}) governs the construct phrase beginning with {{ar:أَيَّىٰمِ}} ({{tr:ayyāmi}}) and parallels the earlier signs-bāʾ.

words.gloss_range: construct plural days: decisive God-authored times, not ordinary calendar units
words.root_gloss_range: day, period, decisive occasion, and event-day; local construct phrase selects remembered divine interventions

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: divine name completing the days construct

words.prose: {{ar:أَيَّىٰمِ}} ({{tr:ayyāmi}}) opens the construct phrase of God's days. Its broken plural makes the remembered object multiple, while the construct with {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) makes those times God-defined: belonging to God and times when God acts. The phrase points to decisive event-days rather than neutral calendar days, with 45:14 as the rare exact parallel and 14:42 providing a later judgment-day contrast.

topics.headline: days defined by God in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees time grammatically bound to God rather than treated as secular chronology.
topics.reason: The noun is the first term of the construct completed by {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}).

topics.headline: decisive event-days rather than calendar dates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the days as memorable divine interventions, not ordinary counted dates.
topics.reason: The broader day/period range survives, but local construct and reminder context select decisive remembered times.

topics.headline: rare phrase linked to wider time field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembered divine days here stand in a wider Quranic time field, including the rare exact parallel in 45:14 and the later judgment contrast in 14:42.
topics.reason: The exact phrase is rare and the same time-root later carries a sharply different judgment valence in the surah.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name completing and definitizing the days construct
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, and overwhelming recognition; local proper name governs the construct as the unique divine referent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct plural days in the remembrance object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) completes {{ar:أَيَّىٰمِ}} ({{tr:ayyāmi}}) as a construct, making the days definite and divinely authored. The fused proper-name form turns the phrase away from generic deity language toward the unique divine name. Worship and bewilderment pressure can enrich the sense of overwhelming divine time, but the local job is to bind remembered history to God's agency across the surah.

topics.headline: divine name completes the remembered days
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the remembered days as divine interventions, not neutral historical periods.
topics.reason: The proper name is the second term of the construct phrase begun by {{ar:أَيَّىٰمِ}} ({{tr:ayyāmi}}).

topics.headline: proper-name uniqueness with worship pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel worshipful and overwhelming recognition around the name while keeping the proper-name function primary.
topics.reason: Derivational and root disputes add pressure, but local grammar uses the fused proper name as the construct governor.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the interpretive coda after the narrated mandate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: fronted locative preposition in the coda
distal demonstrative gathering the prior narrative
benefactive lām naming the receptive audience

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) shifts the verse from commission narrative into interpretive conclusion. The clause fronts {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) before the delayed sign noun, and the following emphatic lām doubles assertion without making the signs exclusive to one audience; {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) names who can receive them.

topics.headline: emphatic interpretive conclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the final clause as a sign-reading coda that classifies the whole preceding event.
topics.reason: The particle opens the final inna-clause and works with the later emphatic {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) around {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}).

words.gloss_range: fronted locative preposition making the prior narrative a container for signs
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) places the interpretive location before the sign noun appears. The preceding commission is first gathered as something in which signs are found, so the narrative itself becomes a container for reflection rather than only a sequence of past actions.

topics.headline: narrative as sign-container
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first receives the preceding event as the place where signs are located.
topics.reason: The fronted prepositional phrase {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) precedes the delayed predicate noun {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}) in the coda.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative compressing the prior commission into one inspectable object
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) packages the many-part sequence into a single referent. It can point broadly to sending, extraction, remembrance, and divine days, or more narrowly to the divine days themselves; the singular demonstrative lets that whole configuration become one object for sign-reading.

topics.headline: prior narrative compressed for inspection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the entire preceding configuration gathered into one object that can contain signs.
topics.reason: Referent evidence supports both broad and narrower antecedents; both enrich the coda without forcing a single exclusive scope.

words.gloss_range: predicate lām certifying the signs in the closing coda and echoing the opening emphasis

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: certification particle in the opening assertion frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) attaches to the sign noun in recitation and intensifies the coda's claim. It answers the opening {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}})-{{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) frame: the ayah begins by certifying the sending and ends by certifying the signs contained in that sending.

topics.headline: closing lām mirrors opening certification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah bracketed by assertion: certified sending at the start, certified signs at the end.
topics.reason: QAC marks this as emphatic lām in the predicate, and the CRITICAL rows tie it to the opening {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}})-{{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) architecture.

words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}) repeats the sign-root but changes the grammar. Unlike possessed {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَآ}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}), this occurrence is indefinite and emphatically marked, so the event contains open-ended signs rather than a closed inventory. The coda formula also assigns reception to {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) {{ar:شَكُورٍ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}), turning signs supplied with Mūsā into signs discerned by patient-grateful readers, with reflection-formula parallels such as 2:164, 3:190, 16:11, and 16:65.

topics.headline: open-ended signs under emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda assert signs broadly, not a fixed closed set.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite with tanwīn and receives emphatic {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) inside the inna-clause.

topics.headline: from divine equipment to human discernment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same sign-root move from mission equipment to discoverable evidence for a qualified audience.
topics.reason: The first sign word is possessed at {{ar:ءَايَٰتِنَآ}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}), while this second occurrence is indefinite and followed by the recipient phrase.

topics.headline: reflection formula with contested root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a Qurʾanic reflection coda while the return-refuge derivation remains only background pressure.
topics.reason: The coda formula is locally active; the ʾ-y-y versus ʾ-w-y dispute enriches the sign noun without replacing it.

words.gloss_range: benefactive lām assigning the signs to a receptive class
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the sign-claim toward its audience. It does not make the signs owned by the recipient; it marks who they are for, so patience and gratitude become the grammar of perception rather than decorative virtues after the fact.

topics.headline: signs assigned to their receptive audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the coda end by defining who can read the signs.
topics.reason: The preposition governs {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) and pivots from sign-presence to recipient qualification.

words.gloss_range: distributive totality over the complete patient-grateful profile
words.root_gloss_range: all/every and totality, with weariness or exhaustion pressure as secondary image-background
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) universalizes access while immediately narrowing it through the quality pair. Its singular form distributes over each complete patient-grateful profile, not over patience alone or gratitude alone. The root's weariness pressure can fit endurance under strain, but the local quantifier sense governs the phrase, and later totality surfaces in 14:25, 14:34, and 14:51 remain a surah-level thread.

topics.headline: every complete patient-grateful profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are for each person who embodies the paired profile, not for one isolated trait.
topics.reason: The quantifier governs the genitive quality phrase {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) {{ar:شَكُورٍ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}).

topics.headline: totality with exhaustion pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel totality tested by strain, while local grammar keeps the word as a distributive quantifier.
topics.reason: The exhaustion branch contributes image-pressure but does not replace the all/every quantifier function.

words.gloss_range: intensive patience: habitual endurance that preserves receptivity through hardship
words.root_gloss_range: patience, restraint, bitter preservation, and endurance under pressure; local faʿʿāl adjective selects constitutive patience

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: intensive gratitude in the recipient profile

words.prose: {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) is not ordinary episodic patience. Its intensive pattern defines the sign-reader by sustained endurance, and the bitter-preservation image sharpens that endurance as the capacity to remain coherent through hardship. It is paired with {{ar:شَكُورٍ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}), so the coda requires endurance through darkness together with grateful recognition of light; the same root continues in 14:12 and 14:21.

topics.headline: endurance as bitter preservation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels patience as preserving coherence under pressure, not passive waiting.
topics.reason: The bitter-aloe and preservation field sharpens the patience quality while local grammar keeps the word as an intensive adjective.

topics.headline: marked constitutive patience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coda selects an intensive patience profile rather than a common patience form.
topics.reason: The faʿʿāl pattern and marked form support habitual or constitutive endurance.

topics.headline: patience paired with gratitude and extended in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees patience as one half of the reception threshold and as a posture developed later in the surah.
topics.reason: The adjective is paired locally with gratitude and the root recurs in 14:12 and 14:21.

words.gloss_range: intensive gratitude: repeated acknowledgment completing the receptive threshold
words.root_gloss_range: gratitude, acknowledgment of benefit, praise of the bestower, and abundance-response imagery; local faʿūl adjective selects constitutive grateful recognition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: intensive patience in the recipient profile

words.prose: {{ar:شَكُورٍ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}) closes the ayah by completing the recipient profile. It matches {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) in case and indefiniteness, so the final phrase names one receptive person rather than two audiences; the appositional possibility only makes gratitude an equal explanatory partner. The faʿūl form marks repeated acknowledgment, while abundance imagery makes gratitude look like fullness in response to favor. Because the word can also describe divine responsiveness elsewhere (35:30, 42:23), the human trait echoes that field without collapsing human and divine roles, and it anticipates 14:7 and 14:37.

topics.headline: gratitude bound to the same recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees endurance and gratitude form one threshold profile for sign-perception.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) and completes the phrase governed by {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}).

topics.headline: acknowledgment and abundance response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands gratitude as returned recognition to the bestower, not a private feeling alone.
topics.reason: Acknowledgment of benefit is the selected local sense; abundance imagery remains positive root pressure.

topics.headline: marked faʿūl gratitude with divine-attribute echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word chooses a marked intensive gratitude form and lightly echoes a divine attribute field.
topics.reason: The faʿūl form supports constitutive gratitude, and parallels such as 35:30 and 42:23 remain attribute-field evidence rather than identity collapse.

topics.headline: gratitude anticipated in later response scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final trait become a concrete response theme in 14:7 and 14:37.
topics.reason: Same-surah sh-k-r surfaces continue the response field after this closing adjective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ ... أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Moses is dispatched with visible markers to open a directed corporate passage: a people separates from plural states of blockage and misplacement and moves toward one illuminating orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sending as release and dispatch supplies the commissioned mover of the passage.
Passage to an outside supplies the actual separation from a prior enclosure or state.
The human collective makes the movement corporate rather than an isolated escape.
Withholding and confinement from a due right supplies the obstructed source-state of the movement.
A conspicuous route-marker makes light a navigable orientation, not merely brightness.

changed_reading.before: A messenger performs a generic rescue from darkness.
changed_reading.after: The ayah scripts an authorized, sign-bearing relocation of a whole people from obstructed placement into a marked and navigable order.

baseline_models.mechanism: The first signs are carried into action, remembrance restores charged episodes to presence, and the resulting passage and recollection become second-order signs. Evidence is recursive rather than a flat list.

activation_trace.role: The visible-marker image spans both the signs initially carried and the signs subsequently found in the event.
A reminder makes what has receded present again, turning event-memory into an active sign-bearing device.
Days as momentous occurrences supply the charged episodes that remembrance reactivates.

changed_reading.before: Miracles and remembered history are two parallel proofs.
changed_reading.after: Given signs initiate a passage whose remembered events train the people to discover further signs, forming a recursive pedagogy of recognition.

baseline_models.mechanism: Intensive endurance holds the self steady long enough for a slight gift or mark to register, while gratitude makes sparse input visibly productive. The pair describes a mode of sign-perception as well as moral qualities.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self against panic supplies continuity under the pressure of the remembered events.
A little input producing a visible effect supplies the receiver's amplifying response to a sign.
Fresh shoots and new growth make grateful reception generative rather than merely verbal.
The visible mark is the input whose effect depends on this holding-and-amplifying receiver.

changed_reading.before: Patient and grateful people are praised after the signs are presented.
changed_reading.after: Patience and gratitude are the coupled receiving apparatus by which pressure is retained and a small disclosure becomes legible and fruitful.

baseline_models.mechanism: The noun for the people activates standing, undertaking, and maintaining branches of its root. Extraction can therefore aim at restoring a corporate body able to rise to, carry, and stabilize an order.

activation_trace.role: The collective of people supplies the direct social anchor.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking recasts the collective as an active bearer of the passage.
Maintenance, care, and governance supply the durable capacity that liberation must restore.

changed_reading.before: Your people names only the population transported by Moses.
changed_reading.after: The population is to be brought into peoplehood as standing capacity: a collective able to undertake and maintain a life beyond its former confinement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first repeats the complete extraction formula for the Book, adds the Lord's permission, and then gives each messenger the language of his people for clarification. The focus command becomes one instance of authorized translation from disclosure into a people's intelligible route.

activation_trace.role: Ordered written speech supplies the transmissible medium that precedes the repeated extraction.
The repeated passage to an outside establishes the focus command as the surah's program.
Permission and authorization qualify the efficacy of the extraction.
Language and speech supply the people's fitted medium of reception.
Uncovering meaning by speech or sign supplies the messenger's functional work.

structural_cues: 14:1 repeats the full movement from plural darknesses to singular light before the focus ayah.
14:4 places every messenger in the language of his people for clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Book, repeated extraction, permission, matched language, and clarification. I infer that bringing out works through authorized intelligibility rather than bare force. A live alternative is that permission marks divine efficacy generally without specifying a translational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Moses is simply empowered to perform one rescue.
changed_reading.after: Moses translates divine signs into an intelligible, authorized route by which his people can undergo the surah-wide movement into light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first remembered day combines bestowed good, rescue by separation, severe harm, spared life, and trial. Gratitude then converts reception into increase, while ingratitude covers the gift; divine self-sufficiency prevents the transaction from being read as supplying a need in God.

activation_trace.role: A good condition bestowed as blessing frames the remembered rescue as gift.
Deliverance by separation gives the remembered day the same passage-shape as the focus command.
A slight input showing an enlarged effect supplies gratitude's productive response.
Increase and growth make the consequence of grateful reception explicit.
Covering a blessing supplies the exact counter-operation to grateful amplification.
Self-sufficiency blocks the reading that gratitude increases God rather than the receiver's field of good.

structural_cues: 14:6 nests rescue, slaughter, preserved lives, and trial inside one act of remembrance.
14:7-8 place increase and punishment beside God's complete self-sufficiency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mixed rescue-and-trial memory, increase after gratitude, covering after ingratitude, and divine self-sufficiency. I infer that remembrance changes the receiver's capacity and future yield. A live alternative is a direct reward-and-punishment sequence without a perceptual or productive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Days of God are past favors to recall with thanks.
changed_reading.after: A Day of God is a mixed event whose rescue and wound must be held together; grateful reading turns that retained event into increased capacity rather than payment to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Messengers commit to endurance under harm, then opponents mirror the focus verb by threatening to expel them or force their return. Destruction of the wrongdoers and settlement after them reverse coercive counter-extraction. Liberation is therefore a conflict over who controls belonging, exit, and durable habitation.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self against panic supplies the messenger's stance immediately before the expulsion threat.
Forced departure from land, community, or allegiance mirrors and contests the focus ayah's commanded extraction.
The fall into destruction removes the coercive regime that claims the power to expel.
Habitation and settlement supply the positive reversal of threatened exile.
Coercive compulsion names the failed mode of the obstinate power.

structural_cues: 14:13 pairs expulsion with compelled return to the opponents' creed.
14:14 answers the threat with dwelling in the land after those opponents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies endurance, counter-expulsion, compelled return, destruction, and replacement by settlement. I infer that the focus darkness includes a coercive belonging-regime that can weaponize exit. A live alternative is to keep the reversal strictly political and spatial without extending it to the focus metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Bringing the people out is a one-directional rescue enacted by an uncontested guide.
changed_reading.after: The extractor enters a struggle in which oppressive orders threaten their own expulsion; patient witness survives until coerced exile is reversed into stable dwelling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered reception yields work that cannot retain form under pressure, like ash dispersed by a forceful wind. Later, once all have emerged for judgment, panic and patience are equally unable to open an exit. The focus pair is productive during the interval of response, not a technique that reverses terminal fixity.

activation_trace.role: Covering blessing supplies the ungrateful reception attached to the unstable work.
Ash left by burning supplies matter with almost no capacity to preserve the work's form.
A violent wind that lightens and scatters things supplies the pressure that tests retention.
Effective capacity is explicitly absent, making lost agency part of the ash mechanism.
The breaking-off of patience supplies one terminal response now declared ineffective.
Self-restraint supplies the opposite response, likewise unable to create an exit once judgment is fixed.

structural_cues: 14:18 links covered reception, accumulated work, scattering, and inability in one material analogy.
14:21 explicitly equates panic and patience after the collective emergence, because no escape remains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable ash-work and a terminal point where neither panic nor patience changes the result. I infer a response-window in which the focus dispositions preserve and grow signs before closure. A live alternative is that 14:21 reports only the condemned speakers' predicament and does not delimit patience generally.

changed_reading.before: Patience and gratitude are timeless badges that remain equally operative in any phase.
changed_reading.after: They are time-sensitive capacities for retaining and growing disclosure before response hardens; neglected signs leave ash-like work and a stage where endurance can no longer reopen the route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later leader-follower reckoning separates verbal following from coercive power. The disowned followers hear that there was only a call and their response, not force, and blame returns to each self. This constrains the focus causative: bringing out facilitates accountable response rather than overriding agency.

activation_trace.role: Allegiance and succession supply the social chain whose responsibility later unravels.
Coercive overpowering is the capacity explicitly denied to the caller.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the actual noncoercive trigger.
The split target's forceful pushing supplies the rejected alternative sharpened by the denial of power.
The self as the very person or entity receives responsibility after the call-and-response chain is exposed.

structural_cues: 14:21 stages followers asking former superiors to remove some punishment and receiving no help.
14:22 contrasts no authority with only calling, response, and self-blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed dependency, denied coercive authority, a call, a response, and self-accountability. I infer that the focus command's causative agency is pedagogical and invitational rather than compulsory. A live alternative is that 14:22 limits only the adversarial caller and says nothing direct about Moses' method.

changed_reading.before: Moses brings people out as objects moved by his power.
changed_reading.after: Moses bears signs and calls intelligibly so that people can answer into the route; the guide mediates exit, but reception remains accountable.

context_deltas.mechanism: A good word becomes a living memory-structure: rooted below, branching above, stable through time, and repeatedly productive. The bad word is removed with its root and has no settlement. Reminding the people is therefore not archival recall alone but installation of speech able to persist, branch, and bear renewed effects.

activation_trace.role: Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible seed of the model.
Deep-rootedness supplies durable retention rather than momentary hearing.
Continuance and stability keep the word active across changing conditions.
A high branch emerging from an origin supplies extension without severance from the remembered root.
Each fitting interval supplies repeated temporal yield rather than a single effect.
The explicit aim of re-presentation ties the tree's recurring yield back to the focus reminder.
Removal in full from the root supplies the failure-mode of speech that cannot retain a ground.
Stability and settlement are explicitly absent from the uprooted counter-word.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 joins rooted speech, repeated yield, divine permission, and the purpose that people remember.
14:26-27 contrasts rootless speech with the fixed word by which believers are stabilized.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies speech, root, branch, recurring yield, remembrance, uprooting, and stability. I infer that remembered signs are cultivated as a durable verbal ecology in the people. A live alternative is that the tree remains an independent comparison for good speech rather than a model of the focus command.

changed_reading.before: Reminding means periodically recounting past events.
changed_reading.after: The reminder plants a stable word whose rooted memory can branch and bear fresh signs at successive times; failed remembrance is uprooted speech with no place to stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing can be replaced by concealment and route a people into ruin, or apportioned provision can be spent onward. Rain, fruit, vessels, rivers, sun, moon, night, and day form continuous services whose gifts exceed counting. Gratitude becomes correct circulation through a field of provision rather than a verbal receipt.

activation_trace.role: One thing standing in place of another supplies the destructive exchange of blessing for concealment.
Bestowed good is the value displaced by the exchange.
Covering blessing supplies the anti-grateful substitute.
Sending wealth out as expenditure supplies an onward route for received provision.
An apportioned gift identifies what is received before it is circulated.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the useful output of the material system.
Directed service toward a purpose makes vessels and rivers channels within the provision system.
Continuous habitual operation supplies the persistence of the sun and moon service.
Exhaustive counting is explicitly exceeded, preventing gratitude from becoming a closed ledger.

structural_cues: 14:28 makes a people's ruin follow the substitution of concealment for blessing.
14:31-34 repeatedly says provision and cosmic services are for you, then declares the blessing-field uncountable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, concealed blessing, expenditure, provision, useful fruit, continuous service, and failed enumeration. I infer a circulation model in which grateful reception keeps gifts moving toward benefit. A live alternative is a sequence of separate duties and creation-signs without a shared flow mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The grateful receiver acknowledges a discrete favor after it arrives.
changed_reading.after: The grateful receiver refuses to replace or cover the gift, recognizes an uncountable support-system, and routes apportioned provision onward into benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Abraham settles descendants where cultivation is absent so that they may establish prayer; provision and fruit are sought so gratitude can grow. The root of the focus noun for people recurs in the act of establishing. Corporate standing becomes a practiced, provisioned settlement transmitted across generations.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate habitation supplies the stable site in which a community can be formed.
Cultivation and growth are explicitly negated at the site, supplying the community's initial material deficit.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking is embodied in establishing prayer.
Apportioned provision supplies the material support for durable standing.
Fresh growth makes gratitude the intended generative outcome of settlement and provision.
Maintenance and care sharpen establishing prayer as an ongoing office rather than a momentary posture.

structural_cues: 14:35-40 moves from a secure place and descendants to settlement, established prayer, provision, gratitude, and renewed prayer for descendants.
The focus root ق و م appears later in forms describing establishment at 14:37 and 14:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barren settlement, repeated ق و م forms for establishing prayer, provision, fruit, gratitude, and descendants. I infer that standing practice helps constitute the people rescued in the focus. A live alternative is that the shared root is only a lexical recurrence across distinct ordinary senses.

changed_reading.before: The people are a pre-existing group that needs relocation.
changed_reading.after: A people becomes able to stand through settled, repeated practice supported by provision and carried into descendants; liberation culminates in maintained communal capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement repeatedly names a coming charged Day, commands warning before it, uses former dwellings as sign-like examples, depicts transformed earth, and ends by defining the discourse as delivered warning and reminder. The focus memory of God's Days becomes a temporal bridge from past event through present response to future accounting.

activation_trace.role: A momentous occurrence supplies the prospective Day of account.
Warning that awakens caution turns the coming Day into a present demand.
The charged Day is repeated as the deadline at which delayed response is requested too late.
An example functioning as lesson and sign makes former dwellings usable evidence for the future.
Transformation of form makes the future Day a radical changed-state rather than ordinary calendar time.
Delivery of a message supplies the closing definition of the discourse as communication reaching people.
Warning again supplies future-oriented vigilance as a purpose of the delivered message.
Re-presentation in the closing purpose returns directly to the focus command to remind.

structural_cues: 14:41, 14:44, and 14:48 progressively specify a future Day of account, punishment, and transformed creation.
14:45 places past dwellings and examples immediately before that future sequence, while 14:52 closes with delivery, warning, knowledge, and remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered former peoples, repeated future Day scenes, warning, transformation, delivered message, and closing remembrance. I infer a temporal bridge in which past Days train response before the future Day. A live alternative is that the focus Days remain only past episodes and the final Day is related by analogy, not included in their scope.

changed_reading.before: Remembering God's Days looks backward at completed interventions.
changed_reading.after: Remembered interventions become signs that orient present conduct toward the still-coming Day, so reminder joins retrospective history to prospective warning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The judgment scene is remote from the focus and makes the reading surprising, but its explicit eyes, prolonged gaze, and empty hearts remain anchored to the focus destination of illumination. Render this only as a contrastive limit: optical exposure is insufficient for guidance, not as a claim that the focus directly predicts the scene.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the focus destination whose perceptual adequacy is being tested.
Fixed staring supplies intense optical exposure without successful orientation.
Eyesight supplies the literal visual faculty present in the scene.
Inner insight supplies the materially absent counterpart to mere eyesight.
Sustained forward gaze intensifies the contrast between looking and guided perception.
A heart weakened as though absent supplies the failed inward receiver.
Void and empty space supply the heart's non-retention despite open eyes.

changed_reading.before: Movement into light can be reduced to seeing what was formerly hidden.
changed_reading.after: The destination requires an inwardly retaining and discerning receiver; eyes can be maximally exposed while the heart remains void.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mountain branch of ص ب ر is form-distant from the adjective and should not replace its ordinary endurance sense. It remains worth carrying because the packet later joins removal from state with solid mountains under plot. Render it as an exploratory material analogy for stability under displacement pressure.

activation_trace.role: A mountain and its middle supply a branch-distant image of a held center.
Removal from place or state supplies the displacement pressure exerted by plotting.
A solid elevated mass supplies the explicit material object threatened with movement.
Hardness that stops excavation sharpens the image of resistance to displacement.

changed_reading.before: The intensely patient person only suppresses panic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the intensely patient person also holds a center like solid terrain when plots seek to shift an entire settled state.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The shared root inventory makes fire a legitimate lexical counterimage to light, and the later fire destination and face-covering fire sharpen the contrast. The reading is still cross-domain and should be rendered as disambiguation, not semantic identity: guiding illumination is not any luminous or burning exposure.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the beneficial destination in the focus.
Burning fire is the neighboring branch that opens the contrast between kinds of luminosity.
Fire as destination supplies a destructive terminus opposed to the focus movement.
Flowing pitch supplies the coating paired with the later fire.
A covering laid over a thing makes the fire an engulfing veil rather than clarifying exposure.
The split target likewise supplies concealment and confirms the covering function without collapsing the mapped roots.
The explicit burning fire covering faces completes the material counterimage to guiding light.

changed_reading.before: Light is beneficial because luminosity itself is beneficial.
changed_reading.after: The focus light is beneficial because it clarifies and orients; the same root-field later supplies fire that covers and consumes, so brightness alone cannot define guidance.

strongest_changes: The exact 14:1 repetition and 14:4 language cue turn Moses' command into authorized translation of signs into a people's route.
14:12-15 mirrors extraction as threatened counter-expulsion and reverses it into durable settlement.
14:24-27 changes reminder from archival recall into rooted speech that persists, branches, and repeatedly bears effects.
14:28-40 links gratitude to circulation, cultivation, settlement, established practice, and transgenerational communal standing.
14:41-52 joins remembered past Days to present warning and the future Day of account.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence made the compact focus ayah behave like a program: message becomes route, liberation meets counter-expulsion, memory takes material forms in ash and trees, gratitude governs provision, and the final notification returns to warning and remembrance.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus Days may denote only past interventions; including the future Day is a context-driven temporal extension.
The people-as-standing model is strongly activated by later ق و م forms, but the move from lexical recurrence to a theory of peoplehood remains inferential.
The mountain-patience and fire-light readings are deliberately retained branch-level outliers and should not displace the nearer focus senses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Remembered days convert rescue into repeatable signs.** `ذ ك ر` `B003` (bringing to mind) and `B009` (admonitory reminder), `ي و م` `B003` (event-day), and `ء ي ي` `B003` (visible sign) connect the historical exit to present discernment. The later sequence repeatedly turns past dwellings and destroyed peoples into visible examples. The packet supplies past events and later inspection; I infer recollection re-presents an event as an operational sign. The command reads as training communal perception, not preserving chronology alone.

2. **Patience and gratitude are complementary retention mechanisms.** `ص ب ر` `B001` restrains panic, while `ش ك ر` `B002` is being sustained by little and showing its effect. Later barren-valley provision and Abraham's thanksgiving sharpen the pair. I infer patience prevents the sign from being lost under stress and gratitude makes its small residue visible; signs become legible to those who both hold and display their effects.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The inhabited examples of 14:45 and final recollection command of 14:52 made the “days of God” look like reusable cognitive instruments, not merely remembered episodes.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Signs become memory-indexed event-days.** `ء ي ي B003` supplies a visible sign, `ذ ك ر B003` bringing to mind, and `ي و م B003` an event-day or severe occasion. The verse repeats `ءَايَات` around the command to remember; 14:6 then supplies a concrete rescue-oppression event and 14:7 its announced consequence. I infer that remembered event-days are the indexing mechanism by which signs stay visible across time. The ayah reads as a program of historical reactivation, not a bare request to recall dates.
2. **Extraction joins cognitive light to social release.** `خ ر ج B002` supplies causing something to come out, and the darkness-light pair repeats 14:1. In 14:6, rescue from an imposed regime supplies the material and social instance of that causative exit. The packet gives the repetition and the rescue; I infer that each illuminates the other. `أَخْرِجْ قَوْمَكَ` therefore carries both reorientation and liberation, without reducing either reading to the other.
3. **Patience and gratitude are interpretive capacities.** `ص ب ر B001` supplies restraint from panic and `ش ك ر B001` recognition and display of favor. The next two ayat expose the remembered material to both ordeal (`ب ل و B002`) and benefaction (`ب ل و B003`), then explicitly contrast gratitude and covering. I infer that restraint preserves an event from panic-driven distortion while gratitude makes its beneficent side legible. `صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ` thus names the reader capable of retaining and displaying the sign.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:6-7 changed the ending pair most sharply. The mixed ordeal/benefaction of `بَلَاء`, followed by gratitude versus covering, showed why patience and gratitude function as capacities for reading event-days rather than generic virtues.

baseline.text: Musa'yı ayetlerimizle göndermiş ve “Halkını karanlıklardan aydınlığa çıkar, onlara Allah'ın günlerini hatırlat” demiştik. Bunda çok sabreden ve çok şükreden herkes için işaretler vardır.

findings.text: Hatırlanan olay günleri, geçmiş kurtuluşu bugün yeniden okunabilen işaretlere dönüştürür.
Karanlıktan çıkarılış, zihinsel yön bulma ile baskıcı bir düzenden toplumsal kurtuluşu birlikte taşır.
Sabır, olayın baskı altında çarpıtılmasını önler; şükür ise nimetin etkisini görünür kılarak ikisini işaretleri okuma yetisine dönüştürür.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sabır ve şükrün işaretleri okuma şartı oluşunu, deniz yolculuğu üzerinden doğrudan yineler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: İlgili kanal yankısı süt akışı ve hısımlıkla sınırlıdır; 14:5'e katkı vermez.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sabır ve şükrü tarihsel dağılma karşısında işaretleri okuyabilen tutumlar olarak paralel kurar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Apaçık ayetleri karanlıklardan nura çıkaran etkin yön işaretleri olarak doğrudan açıklar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: 14:5'in karanlıklardan nura çıkarma hareketini kitabın görevi ve yol bağlamına yerleştirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Gizli bir kaynağın görünür hale çıkışı, çıkarılma yönüne maddi bir paralel sunar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Musa'nın ayetlerle Firavun ve ileri gelenlerine gönderilmesini 14:5'in sahnesine doğrudan bağlar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Şükür ve inkârın 14:5 sonrasındaki karşıt sonuç bağlamını kurar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Çıkarılmış topluluğu insanlar için iyiliği yürürlüğe koyan bir işlev olarak gösterir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Sabır ve şükrün, durma ve imkanın geri gelişi içinde ayetleri okuma yetisi olduğunu doğrudan paraleller.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Kurtarılmış soyun devamını şükürle ilişkilendirerek kurtuluşun korunmuş sürekliliğini ekler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Korunan maddi izi sonraki hatırlama için ayet kılması, Allah'ın günlerini hatırlatma yönünü destekler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Musa'nın ayetler ve apaçık yetkiyle gönderilmesini 14:5'e ikinci doğrudan tanıklık olarak ekler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: 14:1-5'in ilahi sahiplik ve inkâr uyarısı çerçevesini sürdürür.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Zorla evden çıkarma ile nura yönelten çıkarılmanın fail ve yön bakımından karşıtlığını korur.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Musa'nın ayetler ve apaçık yetkiyle gönderilişini tekrarlar; önceki doğrudan kartlara yeni bir boyut eklemez.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Elçinin kendi kavminin diliyle açıklamasını, 14:5'teki bildirim ve hatırlatma görevine bağlar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Ayrıntılı ayetlerin hatırlayanlar için yolu yeniden kurulabilir kılması, hatırlatma işlevini destekler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Musa'ya verilen ayırt edici ölçü, ışık ve hatırlatmayı 14:5'in Musa-ayetler sahnesine paraleller.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Elçi gönderilmeden sorumluluk olmaması, 14:5'in elçilik yönüne yalnız dolaylı bağlanır.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Örneğin ürün vermesi ve insanların hatırlaması, 14:5'teki hatırlatmanın aynı sure içindeki işleyişini gösterir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Karanlıklardan nura çıkarma ve dosdoğru yola iletme formülünü doğrudan yineler.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi gönderme veya serbest bırakma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi, elçi, rüzgar veya yağmur bir hedefe yöneltildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlığı harekete geçirip bir yöne yollamayı korur.
error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tutulan bir canlı veya denetlenen bir güç üzerindeki engel kaldırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tutmayı bırakıp serbest hareket imkanı verme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, doğal güçlerin yöneltilmesini ve tutulan bir şeyin salıverilmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir kişi, hayvan veya topluluğun belirli bir ihtiyaç ya da hedef için görevlendirilerek yollanmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın bir hedefe doğru hareket ettirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın serbest bırakma ve doğal güçleri gönderme alanı daha geniştir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise amaçlı görevlendirmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haber veya görev için yollamayı da açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, engeli kaldırma, yol açma ve çözme gibi daha genel kolaylaştırma biçimlerine uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir varlığın tutulmadan hareket etmesine imkan verebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta gönderme işlemi kurucudur; komşuda asıl vurgu hareketi engelleyen bağı kaldırmaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gönderme veya salıverme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gönderilen haber taşıyıcısını ya da taşınan haberin kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı gönderici, taşıma ve hedef senaryosunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Eylem ile o eylemin taşıyıcısı veya içeriği birbirinin yerine kullanılamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
İçerik okumasında sözcük, taşıyıcının götürdüğü sözün veya haberin kendisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, gönderici ile alıcı arasındaki aktarımı hem taşıyıcı kişi hem de taşınan söz bakımından kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi ile içerik arasında kurduğu iki yönlü adlandırmayı en kısa biçimde birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gönderen adına hareket eden kişiyi hem de onun taşıdığı iletiyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz veya haber taşıyan kişinin kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gönderen adına haber taşıyan kişi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisini adlandırmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Taşınan sözün veya haberin kendisi kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göndericiden alıcıya taşınan içerik yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İçeriği taşıyan kişiyi adlandırmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iletinin alıcıya ulaştırılması ve bildirilmesi işlemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir haberin göndericiden alıcıya ulaşması senaryosundadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta taşıyıcı veya içerik, komşuda ise başarıyla ulaştırma eylemi kurucudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, taşınan sözün kendisini de adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalın kişi anlamı vekillik ve güvence üstlenme rollerine de uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da başkası adına iş gören veya haber taşıyan bir kişi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak haber taşıma ve ileti içeriğine bağlıdır; komşu temsil ve güvence rollerini de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal taşıyıcı kişiyi veya taşınan haberi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bunları yola çıkarma ya da başka bir şeyi salıverme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal gönderici, hedef ve hareket bağlantısını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinde katılımcı veya içerik, ötekinde eylem anlamın merkezindedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sekiz dış aday ile on kardeş dalın tümü değerlendirildi; taşıyıcı, ileti ve iletme eylemi arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren üç aday yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yürüyüş, uzuv ve saç gerçekleşmelerini tek bir fiziksel nitelik altında kapsayan kavramsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın veya topluluğun zorlanmadan ilerlemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dirençsiz ve kolay hareket niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Saçın veya uzuvların yumuşak ve salık oluşunu kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan aşağı doğru uzanması anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yumuşak ve serbest uzanma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kolay yürüyüş ve yumuşak eklem yönlerini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da zorlamasız ve yumuşak ilerleyişi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal yalnız yürüyüş eylemine bağlıdır; odak dal aynı niteliği beden yapısına ve saça da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, özellikle yürüyüşün akıcılığını ve saçın salık uzanmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, huyda yumuşaklık, kolaylaştırma ve insanlarla hoşgörülü davranma gibi soyut alanlara da uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sertliğin yokluğunu ve kolaylığı ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak fiziksel hareket ve biçimle sınırlıyken komşu daha genel nitelik ve davranış alanını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bedeni zorlamayan rahat ilerleyişi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sırtı yoran ve güçsüzü kapasitesinin üstünde zorlayan sert ilerleyişi belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yürüyüşü harcanan güç ve bedensel yük bakımından değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Aynı çaba ekseninde odak düşük direnç ve rahatlığı, komşu yüksek yük ve zorlamayı kodlar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه السير السهل ولين القوائم والمفاصل والشعر المسترسل والإبل المراسيل والبعير السهل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو إرسال الرسالة ولا اللبن ولا القطيع

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iş, konuşma ve okumada aceleyi bırakıp sakin, ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemeyi ortak çekirdek yapar. Çerçevedeki yavaşlık, ağırbaşlılık ve dikkat bu çekirdeğin birbirini tamamlayan yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, acele etmeden ölçülü davranma ve okumayı kapsar; ardışık topluluk veya taşınan ileti anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel temkin niteliği korunur; yavaş ol buyruğu, iş ve konuşmadaki tutum ile okumadaki açık söyleyiş kendi kullanım sınırlarında ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, konuşmayı veya okumayı aceleye getirmeden; sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık, dikkat ve denetimle yürütmektir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, aceleyi bırakıp ölçülü ve denetimli ilerlemektir.
İş ve konuşmada sakinlik, ağırbaşlılık ve karar vermeden önce sağlamlaştırma öne çıkar.
Okumada metni acele etmeden açık, belirgin ve dikkatli söyleme kastedilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, acele etmeme buyruğunu ve iş, konuşma, okuma alanlarındaki sakin, dikkatli ilerleyişi ortak bir ölçülülük çekirdeğinde birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insan veya hayvanların tek bir kütle halinde değil, biri ötekinin ardından gelen ayrı kümeler halinde gelişini ve bu kümelerin her birini anlatır. Çerçeve, topluluk ile ardışıklık bileşenlerini birlikte korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, peş peşe gelen ayrı toplulukları ve sürüleri kapsar; haber taşıyıcısını veya sütün kendisini kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanların, develerin, koyunların veya başka varlıkların ayrı topluluklar halinde, bir küme ötekinin ardından gelecek biçimde ilerlemesi ya da bu kümelerin her biridir.

İnsan ve at topluluklarında da grup grup, biri diğerinin ardından gelme anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü süt için kullanır, bol ve art arda meme akışını bu adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak verir ve bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde etmesini aynı dala bağlar. Çerçeve madde, akış ve elde edilebilirlik ayrımlarını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sütü, özellikle bol ve sürekli gelen sütü kapsar; sürü, ileti veya genel bolluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım süt çekirdeğini korur; sütün bolluğu ile bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder hale gelmesi ayrı sözcük kullanımları olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hayvandan elde edilen süt, özellikle memeden bol ve art arda gelen süt; ayrıca bir topluluğun hayvanlarından süt elde eder duruma gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Dalın somut çekirdeği hayvandan elde edilen süttür.
Sütün bol olması ve memeden kesintisiz ya da art arda gelmesi özellikle vurgulanabilir.
Topluluğa uygulanan kullanım, hayvanlarının süt vermesi sayesinde süt sahibi duruma gelmelerini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sözcüğü süt için verir; bolluk ve memeden sürekli geliş niteliğini belirtir, ayrıca hayvanlarından süt elde etmeye başlayan topluluğu aynı anlam alanına bağlar.
